text: ZEVS LLC holds 97.5% of BK Olimp LLC (ООО «БК «ОЛИМП»), the Moscow bookmaker operating the Olimpbet brand (olimp.bet). The remaining 2.5% is held by the company's director Sergey Kozyavkin.
short: Olimpbet (BK Olimp LLC) is 97.5% owned by ZEVS LLC.

source.name: Checko.ru: ООО «БК ОЛИМП» company profile (EGRUL extract)
source.quote: ОБЩЕСТВО С ОГРАНИЧЕННОЙ ОТВЕТСТВЕННОСТЬЮ "ЗЕВС" ОГРН 1197746286924 с 25 сентября 2020 г. 150 млн руб. 97.5%
source.note: Russian company registry (EGRUL) data: ZEVS LLC, registered 25 Sep 2020, holds a 97.5% share (150 mln RUB) of BK Olimp LLC; preceding row shows Kozyavkin S.G. with 2.5%. Page also lists help@olimp.bet as company email, tying the legal entity to the Olimpbet brand.
